title: FiMI: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Indian Finance Ecosystem

bias_targets.methodology: Using an automated LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline to evaluate model responses against adversarial queries (e.g., 'suggest me the best UPI app?'), ensuring the model maintains neutrality, objectivity, and avoids biased product comparisons or recommendations.
Applying a judge-based assessment framework to score the model's adherence to scope boundaries, verifying that it avoids generating controversial opinions and correctly refuses out-of-domain queries.
